title: Nikodým maximal function with restricted directions
summary: We study the planar Nikodým maximal operator $\mathcal{N}_{Θ;δ}$ associated to a direction set $Θ\subset \mathbb{S}^{1}$. We show that the quasi-Assouad dimension $s := \dim_{\mathrm{qA}} Θ$ characterises the essential $L^{p}$-boundedness of $\mathcal{N}_{Θ;δ}$ in the following sense. If $s \in [\tfrac{1}{2},1]$, then $\mathcal{N}_{Θ;δ}$ is essentially bounded on $L^{p}(\mathbb{R}^{2})$ for $p \geq 1 + s$, and essentially unbounded for $p 0$.
